item.title: Utah Supreme Court declines Legislature’s request to block new congressional map
item.description: A Utah Supreme Court panel denied the Legislature's request to stay a district court ruling implementing a new congressional map.

item.title: Girl killed in Brighton Ski Resort avalanche identified as 11-year-old from Massachusetts
item.description: Police have identified the girl killed in Thursday's avalanche as an 11-year-old from Massachusetts skiing with her family.

item.title: Cortina collector lines his restaurant with Olympic torches
item.description: At a restaurant called Al Passetto in Cortina d'Ampezzo, Olympic torches line the walls.

item.title: Utah Parole Board will soon launch next phase of victim notification system
item.description: Utah’s Board of Pardons and Parole is close to launching the next phase of its MyVoice notification system, giving survivors greater control over how they receive updates and adding new safety features. The improvements follow KSL Investigators’ reporting on notification failures and build on reforms first unveiled in 2025.

item.title: Man dies in snowmobile accident near Iron Mine Mountain
item.description: According to the Wasatch County Sheriff's Office. a snowmobiler was found dead after what appeared to be a crash that trapped him under the vehicle.

item.title: No injuries reported after shots fired during fight on Salt Lake City sidewalk
item.description: No injuries were reported after the Salt Lake City Police Department responded to shots being fired Friday night during a fight involving several people, police said.

item.title: Utah Jazz Fall To Grizzlies In Critical Standings Matchup
item.description: he Utah Jazz dropped their first game after the All-Star break, losing to the Memphis Grizzlies 123-114 on Friday night.

item.title: 15 new measles cases in Utah share a common trait – where they’re coming from
item.description: There were 15 new measles cases this past week and for the second time in a month, the Utah DHHS reported measles outbreaks coming from wrestling matches.

item.title: Utah Mammoth open Sandy Ice Center for public skating and training
item.description: The Utah Mammoth celebrated the Grand Opening of their Ice Center in Sandy on Friday.

item.title: Utah rent reporting bill hits roadblock
item.description: Sen. Jen Plumb, D-Salt Lake City, said she wants to help renters improve their credit and inch closer to homeownership by having their rental payment history reported to consumer reporting agencies.
